subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Twitch: Watching People Play
description: Learn Twitch: Watching People Play in one minute.

hook.text: Justin Kan strapped a camera to his head in 2007 and streamed his entire life online.

buildup.text: Justin.tv pivoted to gaming streams. Twitch was born — a site for watching people play.

discovery.text: Chat interaction made viewers feel like part of the action, not passive observers.

twist.text: Amazon bought Twitch for $970 million, outbidding Google. Live gaming was serious business.

climax.text: Twitch proved that watching someone play a game could be as entertaining as playing it.
